evals.prompt: I've got a Spring Boot 3.4 app (Java 21, Maven) called order-sync that runs on a Hetzner box. Right now I build the jar locally and scp it up, which is painful. I want to Dockerize it and set up GitHub Actions so that when I tag a release it builds the image, pushes to GHCR, and deploys over SSH. There's Traefik in front doing HTTPS, and Postgres runs on a separate managed instance. Can you set all that up?
evals.expected_output: Interviews for the open facts (registry auth, arch, tag-vs-branch trigger, Traefik network/domain/entrypoint/resolver, server path/secrets). Produces a multi-stage Dockerfile using jarmode tools + java -jar application.jar (not layertools/JarLauncher), non-root, temurin/glibc; .dockerignore; compose.prod.yaml with Traefik labels, no published port, DB_URL from .env (remote DB, no extra_hosts); deploy.yml with test->build->deploy, GHCR via ephemeral GITHUB_TOKEN, scp+ssh, tag-triggered. Verifies with docker build + launch smoke-test.

evals.prompt: we already have a working Dockerfile for our spring boot service (built with the layertools thing). i need the github actions side — build + push to ghcr on a git tag, then ssh into our server and docker compose pull/up. the box is arm64 (oracle cloud free tier). secrets are already in the repo as SSH_HOST etc.
evals.expected_output: Focuses on the pipeline (workflow + compose) rather than re-doing the Dockerfile, but flags that layertools is deprecated for Boot 3.2+/tools. Sets platforms: linux/arm64 (with QEMU or native arm runner). Uses GHCR ephemeral GITHUB_TOKEN, scp+ssh deploy keyed off the existing SSH_* secrets. Verifies action versions exist.

evals.prompt: help me containerize this Spring Boot 4 collector and deploy it. nginx is our reverse proxy (config files, not docker labels), and postgres is installed right on the same server (not in docker). want CI/CD via github actions + GHCR.
evals.expected_output: Dockerfile (jarmode tools, non-root, temurin/glibc). compose.prod.yaml publishes to 127.0.0.1:8080 (nginx file-based proxy, not Traefik labels) and reaches the same-host Postgres via extra_hosts host.docker.internal:host-gateway with DB_URL pointed there. Warns that DB_URL must NOT be localhost inside the container. deploy.yml tag-triggered GHCR + scp/ssh. Verifies with a build.
